column1: # Parts of hyphenated words without a stress of their own. Other parts are words of their own, each with its stress.
# prefix: the first part; suffix: any part but the first. Of one-syllable parts in a row only the last one is stressed.
# Names of letters: a hyphenated word made of them only reads as one word stressed on its last part.
# A part before a hyphen spelled with «е» that reads with «ё» (as a word of its own it may read otherwise).
